description: Ministry of National Integration & Reconciliation - Order under office on missing persons Act, effective date 15.09.2017, Provisions of Parts I,II,III & V (Aforesaid Act shall come into operation on 15.09.2017)
categorisation: This gazette content announces the operational date for specific parts of an Act (Office on Missing Persons Act) through a ministerial order. It deals with the implementation of legislation (Act No. 14 of 2016 as amended by Act No. 9 of 2017), which falls under legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel or structural changes.
